title: Hypnotic Induction - Learning to Let Go
description:
You came back for this, didn’t you? Yes, I knew you would.

Last time, you learned what hypnosis really is. Now you are ready to learn the one skill that changes everything. I am going to teach you how to let go, truly let go, without forcing or trying or pushing. Just a simple, natural release that lets you sink deeper than you have ever gone before.

This session is called Learning to Let Go, and I made it for everyone who wants to move past the busy mind and find that still, quiet place inside. You will practice with me, breath by breath, thought by thought, until letting go becomes easy and automatic.

You are already curious about how it would feel to be that calm, that free, that deep. So why wait? Press play and let me guide you there. I am already waiting.

Features
author: Mistress Amethyst
